15"""Element-wise in-place equality (eq_ / eq_scalar_), GCU400-optimized. 

16 

17The previous path ran every shape through the global ``pointwise_dynamic`` 

18template, whose ENFLAME ``CodeGenConfig`` caps the launch grid at 

19``(12, 1, 1)`` with 4096-element tiles: every shape beyond ~2**24 elements 

20serialized onto 12 CTAs (bench core baseline 2026-11-13: eq_ 2**30 

2112.56-12.82 ms, ~0.5-0.9 TB/s effective; eq_scalar_ 11.08-11.45 ms) and 

22paid the fp32 up-cast compare on top. 

23 

24This module mirrors the out-of-place ``.eq`` and the in-place 

25``.greater_equal_`` siblings: large contiguous same-dtype float inputs are 

26dispatched to the flat / strided 1D kernels reused from ``.eq``, passing 

27``A`` as ``OUT`` -- the kernels store ``r.to(OUT.dtype.element_ty)``, so the 

28bool result lands in ``A`` cast to A's dtype, matching torch ``eq_`` 

29semantics (0.0/1.0 written into the float self tensor). 

30 

31* comparisons run in the native input dtype (bit-exact for same-dtype 

32 floats; the fp32 up-cast is an injective map, so ``==`` is preserved); 

33* the scalar overload casts the Python scalar to ``A.dtype`` before 

34 comparing, matching torch TensorIterator semantics (the fp32-compare 

35 template deviates from torch on fp16 round-down scalars such as 0.1); 

36* small (< 2**16) / non-contiguous / broadcast / non-float inputs fall back 

37 to the ``pointwise_dynamic`` kernels from ``.eq``. 

38 

39In-place-validated tiers (do_bench kernel-mode median, w1000/r100; the 

402026-11-13 tiers plus the 2026-11-18 re-tune, which moves the tensor arms 

41and the f16/bf16 scalar mid band to DSM dual-program (loads <= 256KB per 

42program) x num_warps=2 forms -- an interaction win: each single-variable 

43change alone loses. The in-place store is itemsize-wide vs the 1-byte bool 

44store out-of-place, which keeps the 48-CTA persistent strided form dominant 

45on the large shapes): 

46 

47 tensor n < 2**16 -> generic pointwise (launch-overhead floor) 

48 tensor f32 [2**16, 2**21) -> flat BLOCK=32768 nw2 (2^17 0.995x / 2^18 

49 1.074x / 2^20 0.995x vs old strided 

50 0.67-0.87x) 

51 tensor f32 n >= 2**21 -> strided 48xB=32768 nw2 (2^21 1.001x / 

52 2^22 1.011x / 2^24 1.043x / 2^26 1.058x; 

53 2^28-2^30 tie the old 64k/nw4 form at 

54 the ~3.0TB/s roofline) 

55 tensor f16/bf16 < 2**22 -> flat BLOCK=65536 nw4 (2^20 1.290x, beats 

56 the new strided form and flat-131k) 

57 tensor f16/bf16 n >= 2**22 -> strided 48xB=65536 nw2 (2^22 1.002x / 

58 2^24 1.041x / 2^26 1.060x / 2^28 1.063x / 

59 2^30 1.055x -- beats flat-131k and the 

60 old strided-131k/nw4 on every point) 

61 scalar n < 2**16 -> flat BLOCK=next_pow2(n) nw4 

62 scalar 2**16..2**22 -> flat BLOCK=65536 nw4 

63 scalar f16/bf16 2**22..2**28 -> strided 48xB=65536 nw2 (2^22 1.078x / 

64 2^24 1.072x / 2^26 1.077x vs flat-131k 

65 1.043-1.067x) 

66 scalar f16/bf16 n >= 2**28 -> flat BLOCK=262144 nw4 (roofline ~3 TB/s; 

67 strided-64k ties within noise, prod kept) 

68 scalar f32 n >= 2**22 -> strided 48xB=65536 nw4 (unchanged: best at 

69 every band point incl. 2^26/2^30) 

70 

71The in-place tiers keep the masked arm everywhere (``EVEN=False``): the 

722026-11-16 re-measure showed the maskless EVEN arm that helps the 

73out-of-place kernels regresses in-place mid shapes (eq_ f16/bf16 2^24 

74+4.1..4.8%, eq_scalar_ f16/bf16 2^24 +4.4..9.9% -- the store writes back 

75through the same pointer the loads read, and dropping the store predicate 

76degrades the emitted access pattern), so the in-place tiers stay on the 

77masked form the 2026-11-13 tuning was measured on. 

78""" 

79 

80import logging 

81 

82import torch 

83import triton 

84 

85from .eq import ( 

86 _BIG_N, 

87 _FLOAT_DTYPES, 

88 _INT32_SAFE_LIMIT, 

89 _MID_N, 

90 _NP2, 

91 _NPROGS, 

92 _SMALL_N, 

93 _eq_cmp_kernel, 

94 _eq_cmp_scalar_kernel, 

95 _eq_cmp_scalar_strided_kernel, 

96 _eq_cmp_strided_kernel, 

97 _launch_with_retry, 

98 eq_func, 

99 eq_func_scalar, 

100) 

101 

102logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

103 

104# fp32 tensor boundary between the flat-32k launch and the persistent 

105# strided-48x32k form (2026-11-18 probes: flat wins 2^16..2^20, strided wins 

106# from 2^21 up). 

107_F32_MID_N = 2**21 

108 

109 

110def _eq_inplace_run(A, B): 

111 """Launch the tuned in-place comparison kernel; False falls back.""" 

112 n = A.numel() 

113 if n < _SMALL_N: 

114 return False 

115 if A.dtype == torch.float32: 

116 # 2026-11-18 re-tune: DSM dual-program (2 loads x 4B x 32768 = 256KB 

117 # <= 448KB/program) combined with num_warps=2 wins the whole fp32 

118 # range over the previous strided 48x65536/nw4 (524KB, single 

119 # program/SP). Flat 32k below 2^21 (launch-floor band: 2^17 0.995x / 

120 # 2^18 1.074x / 2^20 0.995x vs old 0.67-0.87x; flat wins there because 

121 # the strided loop only spans 2-32 tiles), persistent strided above 

122 # (2^21 1.001x / 2^22 1.011x / 2^24 1.043x / 2^26 1.058x; 2^28-2^30 

123 # tie with the old form at the ~3.0TB/s roofline). 

124 block = 32768 

125 if n > _INT32_SAFE_LIMIT - block: 

126 return False 

127 if n >= _F32_MID_N: 

128 _launch_with_retry( 

129 lambda: _eq_cmp_strided_kernel[(_NPROGS,)]( 

130 A, B, A, n, BLOCK=block, EVEN=False, num_warps=2 

131 ) 

132 ) 

133 else: 

134 _launch_with_retry( 

135 lambda: _eq_cmp_kernel[(triton.cdiv(n, block),)]( 

136 A, B, A, n, BLOCK=block, EVEN=False, num_warps=2 

137 ) 

138 ) 

139 return True 

140 if n >= _MID_N: 

141 # f16/bf16 >= 2^22: strided 48x65536 nw2 -- DSM dual-program 

142 # (2 x 2B x 65536 = 256KB) x nw2. Beats the previous flat-131072 / 

143 # strided-48x131072/nw4 tiers on every band point (2^22 1.002x / 

144 # 2^24 1.041x / 2^26 1.060x / 2^28 1.063x / 2^30 1.055x); the win is 

145 # the interaction -- single-variable probes all lose (64k+nw4 

146 # 0.929x, 131k+nw2 1.000x, flat131k 0.939x, st1/st2/st3 neutral). 

147 if n > _INT32_SAFE_LIMIT - 65536: 

148 return False 

149 _launch_with_retry( 

150 lambda: _eq_cmp_strided_kernel[(_NPROGS,)]( 

151 A, B, A, n, BLOCK=65536, EVEN=False, num_warps=2 

152 ) 

153 ) 

154 return True 

155 # [2^16, 2^22) keeps the 2026-11-13 flat launch (2^20: 1.290x, beats 

156 # strided-64k-nw2 1.196x and flat-131k 1.192x). 

157 block = 65536 

158 if n > _INT32_SAFE_LIMIT - block: 

159 return False 

160 _launch_with_retry( 

161 lambda: _eq_cmp_kernel[(triton.cdiv(n, block),)]( 

162 A, B, A, n, BLOCK=block, EVEN=False, num_warps=4 

163 ) 

164 ) 

165 return True 

166 

167 

168def eq_(A, B): 

169 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME EQ_") 

170 if A.device != B.device: 

171 B = B.to(A.device) 

172 if ( 

173 A.dtype == B.dtype 

174 and A.dtype in _FLOAT_DTYPES 

175 and A.shape == B.shape 

176 and A.is_contiguous() 

177 and B.is_contiguous() 

178 ): 

179 if _eq_inplace_run(A, B): 

180 return A 

181 return eq_func(A, B, out0=A) 

182 

183 

184def eq_scalar_(A, B): 

185 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME EQ_SCALAR_") 

186 if isinstance(B, (int, float)) and A.dtype in _FLOAT_DTYPES and A.is_contiguous(): 

187 try: 

188 y = float(B) 

189 except (OverflowError, ValueError): 

190 return eq_func_scalar(A, B, out0=A) 

191 n = A.numel() 

192 if n > 0: 

193 if n >= _MID_N: 

194 if A.dtype == torch.float32: 

195 if n > _INT32_SAFE_LIMIT - 65536: 

196 return eq_func_scalar(A, B, out0=A) 

197 _launch_with_retry( 

198 lambda: _eq_cmp_scalar_strided_kernel[(_NPROGS,)]( 

199 A, A, n, y, BLOCK=65536, EVEN=False, num_warps=4 

200 ) 

201 ) 

202 return A 

203 # f16/bf16: [2^22, 2^28) strided 48x65536 nw2 (2026-11-18: 

204 # beats flat-131072/nw4 on the whole band -- 2^22 1.078x / 

205 # 2^24 1.072x / 2^26 1.077x vs flat 1.043-1.067x; single load 

206 # x 2B x 65536 = 128KB, dual-program 48-way); the giant band 

207 # keeps the flat 262144/nw4 launch (2^28 337.56 vs 336.77us, 

208 # 2^30 1331.9 vs 1333.3us -- within noise, prod tier kept). 

209 # DSM Required counts loads only (probe-verified in-place: 

210 # BLOCK=262144 compiles, Required = itemsize * BLOCK = 512 KB) 

211 if n < _BIG_N: 

212 if n > _INT32_SAFE_LIMIT - 65536: 

213 return eq_func_scalar(A, B, out0=A) 

214 _launch_with_retry( 

215 lambda: _eq_cmp_scalar_strided_kernel[(_NPROGS,)]( 

216 A, A, n, y, BLOCK=65536, EVEN=False, num_warps=2 

217 ) 

218 ) 

219 return A 

220 block = 262144 

221 elif n >= _SMALL_N: 

222 block = 65536 

223 else: 

224 # shape-matched tile for launch-floor shapes: a fixed 16384-wide 

225 # vector wastes 4x lanes on (64,64)-class fp32 inputs (+1.5us) 

226 block = max(256, min(16384, _NP2(n))) 

227 if n <= _INT32_SAFE_LIMIT - block: 

228 _launch_with_retry( 

229 lambda: _eq_cmp_scalar_kernel[(triton.cdiv(n, block),)]( 

230 A, A, n, y, BLOCK=block, EVEN=False, num_warps=4 

231 ) 

232 ) 

233 return A 

234 return eq_func_scalar(A, B, out0=A)
